scripts.docker:checksum: sh -c 'if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then shasum -a 256 aodit-latest.tar.gz | awk "{print \$1}" > aodit-latest.tar.gz.sha256; elif command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum aodit-latest.tar.gz | awk "{print \$1}" > aodit-latest.tar.gz.sha256; else echo "No SHA-256 tool found. Install shasum or sha256sum." >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --env-file on-prem/.env.onprem -f on-prem/docker-compose.onprem.yml logs -f aodit
scripts.docker:logs:db: docker compose --env-file on-prem/.env.onprem -f on-prem/docker-compose.onprem.yml logs -f mongodb
